text:
QUOTE: Returned `char*` (e.g. `entropic_run` out-param, ...) | Caller owns; free with `entropic_free()` ... Returned `const char*` (e.g. `entropic_version`) | Static, or owned by the handle until the next call on that handle | Do not free; do not hold past the next call
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The table states both rules: char* is caller-owned and freed with entropic_free, while const char* is handle-owned and valid only until the next call on that handle.
